children: Kura Oncology appointed Jennifer Fulk as Chief Financial Officer, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer, effective September 8, 2026.
Chief Financial Officer; principal financial officer; principal accounting officer
Replaces Troy E. Wilson as principal financial officer (solely for that role) and Thomas Doyle as principal accounting officer (solely for that role)

Former CFO of Soleno Therapeutics (Mar–May 2026); COO & CFO of 120Water (Sep 2024–Oct 2025); CFO of Talkspace (Jul 2021–May 2024); 15+ years in finance roles at Eli Lilly; BS (Information Systems) and MBA, Indiana University

title: Jennifer Fulk named CFO of Kura Oncology, replacing Troy E. Wilson and Thomas Doyle
